name: Annual bonus
authority: EPF Act 1991 (Act 452) s.2 "wages" includes any bonus (AGC text as at 1 July 2022); PCB additional remuneration (LHDN MTD Specification 2026 D(b)(2)). Excluded from SOCSO, EIS and SKBBK wages by Act 4 s.2(24)(e) "bonus tahunan" (PERKESO BM reprint as at 1 July 2021, p.18) and Act 800 s.2 "wages" (e) "any annual bonus", and from HRD wages by Act 612 s.2 "wages" (e) "any bonus or commission" (AGC reprint 2017).

name: Long service award
authority: ITA 1967 Schedule 6 para 25C (AGC online text as at 1 January 2026): a long service award is exempt up to RM2,000 per year of assessment after more than ten years with the same employer; the rest is additional remuneration for MTD (LHDN MTD Specification 2026 D(b)(2), E(9) item v) — PCB.assessed_on subtracts the exempt part. EPF Act 1991 s.2 "wages" (AGC text as at 1 July 2022) excludes (c) "any gratuity", unqualified, and KWSP's employer FAQ (Mandatory Contribution, Q11 "Non-Wages", read 28 September 2026) lists "Gratuity" among payments not liable. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on whether a long service award is a gratuity; default — it is (a payment in recognition of length of service, not remuneration for work done), so outside EPF; lawful because s.2 excludes every gratuity and s.43 charges only "wages". Act 4 s.2(24)(d) (PERKESO BM reprint as at 1 July 2021) and Act 800 s.2 "wages" (d) exclude only a gratuity "payable on discharge or retirement", and (e) only an annual bonus, so an award paid in service is SOCSO, EIS and (A1788, from 1 June 2026) SKBBK wages. Act 612 s.2 "wages" (AGC reprint 2017) is basic salary, fixed allowances, leave pay and arrears: a one-off award is none of them, so outside the HRD levy. A past-achievement, service-excellence, innovation or productivity award (the rest of para 25C) is not this class.

name: Past achievement, service excellence, innovation or productivity award
authority: ITA 1967 Schedule 6 para 25C (AGC online text as at 1 January 2026): a perquisite consisting of a past achievement, service excellence, innovation or productivity award, whether in money or otherwise, is exempt up to RM2,000 per employee per year of assessment — one cap shared with the long service award (which counts only after more than ten years with the same employer); LHDN Public Ruling 5/2019 Perquisites from Employment (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/PR_05_2019_2.pdf) para 7.1.1 and Example 11 (p.18): the RM2,000 covers the awards together. LHDN Specification for MTD Calculations Using Computerised Calculation 2026 (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/spesifikasi-kaedah-pengiraan-berkomputer-pcb-2026.pdf), E(9), pp.20–22, read 28 September 2026 item v: the exempt part is excluded from MTD remuneration and the rest is additional remuneration (D(b)(2) “bonus/incentive”); PCB.assessed_on subtracts the shared exemption. EPF Act 1991 s.2 “wages” (AGC text as at 1 July 2022) includes any bonus, commission or allowance and excludes any travelling allowance; KWSP employer FAQ (Mandatory Contribution, Q8 “Components of Wage”: salary, bonus, allowance, commission, incentives; Q11 “Non-Wages”: travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession; read 28 September 2026 in the browser): an award is a bonus or incentive, so EPF wages (additional). Act 4 s.2(24) (PERKESO BM reprint as at 1 July 2021) and Act 800 s.2 “wages” exclude (b) any travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession, (c) sums to defray special expenses entailed by the nature of the employment, (d) a gratuity on discharge or retirement and (e) an annual bonus: an in-service award is none of these, so SOCSO, EIS and (A1788, from 1 June 2026) SKBBK wages. Act 612 s.2 “wages” (AGC reprint 2017): basic salary and fixed allowances or other emoluments of a like nature paid in cash, excluding (b) any travelling allowance, (c) special expenses and (e) any bonus or commission: an award is no fixed allowance and is a bonus, so outside the HRD levy. A long service award is its own class, LONG_SERVICE_AWARD.

name: Travelling, petrol or toll allowance for official duties

name: Benefit in kind or living accommodation (monthly value, MTD Y1)
authority: LHDN Specification for MTD Calculations Using Computerised Calculation 2026 (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/spesifikasi-kaedah-pengiraan-berkomputer-pcb-2026.pdf), E(11)–(12), p.23, read 28 September 2026: benefits-in-kind (BIK) and the value of living accommodation (VOLA) are treated as part of Y1 in the current year only and are used only for the MTD calculation — they “shall not appear in the pay slip and EA Form as gross salary/remuneration”; the entry is the monthly amount the employer keys in (method i), or the year's value ÷ the remaining working months including the current one (method ii, which the employer computes before entry). E(9) items iii–iv (one device and its bills per asset category) and viii (subsidised housing, education or car loan interest where the loans do not exceed RM300,000, else the A × B ÷ C formula) are exempt, so only a taxable excess is entered here. name: Termination benefit
authority: Employment (Termination and Lay-Off Benefits) Regulations 1980 reg.6(1): an employee of twelve months’ continuous service whose contract is terminated other than for misconduct, retirement or resignation is paid ten days’ wages for every year of service under two years, fifteen under five and twenty at five or more, pro rata for a part year; reg.4(1)(b) excludes misconduct dismissal after due inquiry. EA 1955 First Schedule paras 1A, 2(1)-(4) and 3: the s.60J wage exclusion does not apply to qualifying manual workers, manual-labour supervisors, commercial vehicle operators or vessel workers, irrespective of wages. The vessel category is excluded from Part XII, not Part XIIA. Domestic employees are excluded from Part XIIA by para.2(5). The statutory work category must represent the applicable First Schedule profile. The separate reg.1A part-time and reg.7 outworker exclusions still require their own classification; this wage-category correction does not close those mechanisms. reg.6(2): "a day's wages" is the average true day's wages over the twelve completed months before the relevant date — JTKSM's published formula is twelve months' wages ÷ 365 (https://jtksm.mohr.gov.my/en/frequently-asked-questions/employees-retrenchment/how-termination-benefit-payment-calculated-and), not the s.60I ordinary rate ÷ 26; the twelve months' wages are the s.2 wages earlier payslips paid (basic, standing allowances, overtime, less unpaid days; `employment.earned_monthly_average(12)` × 12), not the contract wage; where the months were paid outside the workspace, the departure's `wages_12m` states them, and a month of service with neither is refused. reg.4(1): payable on termination "for any reason whatsoever" other than contractual retirement, misconduct after due inquiry or voluntary resignation — a RETRENCHMENT or UNILATERAL termination is inside it.

name: Indemnity owed for unserved notice
authority: Employment Act 1955 ss.13(1),24(2)(b): indemnity owed by the party ending employment to the other party. name: Annual bonus
authority: EPF Act 1991 (Act 452) s.2 "wages" includes any bonus (AGC text as at 1 July 2022); PCB additional remuneration (LHDN MTD Specification 2026 D(b)(2)). name: Long service award
authority: ITA 1967 Schedule 6 para 25C (AGC online text as at 1 January 2026): a long service award is exempt up to RM2,000 per year of assessment after more than ten years with the same employer; the rest is additional remuneration for MTD (LHDN MTD Specification 2026 D(b)(2), E(9) item v) — PCB.assessed_on subtracts the exempt part. EPF Act 1991 s.2 "wages" (AGC text as at 1 July 2022) excludes (c) "any gratuity", unqualified, and KWSP's employer FAQ (Mandatory Contribution, Q11 "Non-Wages", read 28 September 2026) lists "Gratuity" among payments not liable. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on whether a long service award is a gratuity; default — it is (a payment in recognition of length of service, not remuneration for work done), so outside EPF; lawful because s.2 excludes every gratuity and s.43 charges only "wages". Act 4 s.2(24)(d) (PERKESO BM reprint as at 1 July 2021) and Act 800 s.2 "wages" (d) exclude only a gratuity "payable on discharge or retirement", and (e) only an annual bonus, so an award paid in service is SOCSO, EIS and (A1788, from 1 June 2026) SKBBK wages. Act 612 s.2 "wages" (AGC reprint 2017) is basic salary, fixed allowances, leave pay and arrears: a one-off award is none of them, so outside the HRD levy. A past-achievement, service-excellence, innovation or productivity award (the rest of para 25C) is not this class.

name: Past achievement, service excellence, innovation or productivity award
authority: ITA 1967 Schedule 6 para 25C (AGC online text as at 1 January 2026): a perquisite consisting of a past achievement, service excellence, innovation or productivity award, whether in money or otherwise, is exempt up to RM2,000 per employee per year of assessment — one cap shared with the long service award (which counts only after more than ten years with the same employer); LHDN Public Ruling 5/2019 Perquisites from Employment (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/PR_05_2019_2.pdf) para 7.1.1 and Example 11 (p.18): the RM2,000 covers the awards together. LHDN Specification for MTD Calculations Using Computerised Calculation 2026 (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/spesifikasi-kaedah-pengiraan-berkomputer-pcb-2026.pdf), E(9), pp.20–22, read 28 September 2026 item v: the exempt part is excluded from MTD remuneration and the rest is additional remuneration (D(b)(2) “bonus/incentive”); PCB.assessed_on subtracts the shared exemption. EPF Act 1991 s.2 “wages” (AGC text as at 1 July 2022) includes any bonus, commission or allowance and excludes any travelling allowance; KWSP employer FAQ (Mandatory Contribution, Q8 “Components of Wage”: salary, bonus, allowance, commission, incentives; Q11 “Non-Wages”: travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession; read 28 September 2026 in the browser): an award is a bonus or incentive, so EPF wages (additional). Act 4 s.2(24) (PERKESO BM reprint as at 1 July 2021) and Act 800 s.2 “wages” exclude (b) any travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession, (c) sums to defray special expenses entailed by the nature of the employment, (d) a gratuity on discharge or retirement and (e) an annual bonus: an in-service award is none of these, so SOCSO, EIS and (A1788, from 1 June 2026) SKBBK wages. Act 612 s.2 “wages” (AGC reprint 2017): basic salary and fixed allowances or other emoluments of a like nature paid in cash, excluding (b) any travelling allowance, (c) special expenses and (e) any bonus or commission: an award is no fixed allowance and is a bonus, so outside the HRD levy. A long service award is its own class, LONG_SERVICE_AWARD.

name: Travelling, petrol or toll allowance for official duties
authority: LHDN Specification for MTD Calculations Using Computerised Calculation 2026 (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/spesifikasi-kaedah-pengiraan-berkomputer-pcb-2026.pdf), E(9), pp.20–22, read 28 September 2026 item i: petrol card, petrol allowance, travelling allowance or toll payment, or any combination, for official duties is exempt up to RM6,000 a year; LHDN Public Ruling 5/2019 Perquisites from Employment (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/PR_05_2019_2.pdf) para 7.2.1 (pp.20–21, Example 17: RM7,200 + RM3,600 → RM6,000 exempt, RM4,800 taxable). PCB.assessed_on and PCB.ordinary_on subtract annual_exempt(…, 6,000); the rest is normal remuneration (spec D(1)). name: Benefit in kind or living accommodation (monthly value, MTD Y1)
authority: LHDN Specification for MTD Calculations Using Computerised Calculation 2026 (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/spesifikasi-kaedah-pengiraan-berkomputer-pcb-2026.pdf), E(11)–(12), p.23, read 28 September 2026: benefits-in-kind (BIK) and the value of living accommodation (VOLA) are treated as part of Y1 in the current year only and are used only for the MTD calculation — they “shall not appear in the pay slip and EA Form as gross salary/remuneration”; the entry is the monthly amount the employer keys in (method i), or the year's value ÷ the remaining working months including the current one (method ii, which the employer computes before entry). name: Long service award
authority: ITA 1967 Schedule 6 para 25C (AGC online text as at 1 January 2026): a long service award is exempt up to RM2,000 per year of assessment after more than ten years with the same employer; the rest is additional remuneration for MTD (LHDN MTD Specification 2026 D(b)(2), E(9) item v) — PCB.assessed_on subtracts the exempt part. EPF Act 1991 s.2 "wages" (AGC text as at 1 July 2022) excludes (c) "any gratuity", unqualified, and KWSP's employer FAQ (Mandatory Contribution, Q11 "Non-Wages", read 28 September 2026) lists "Gratuity" among payments not liable. Owner rule 2026-09-28: law silent on whether a long service award is a gratuity; default — it is (a payment in recognition of length of service, not remuneration for work done), so outside EPF; lawful because s.2 excludes every gratuity and s.43 charges only "wages". Act 4 s.2(24)(d) (PERKESO BM reprint as at 1 July 2021) and Act 800 s.2 "wages" (d) exclude only a gratuity "payable on discharge or retirement", and (e) only an annual bonus, so an award paid in service is SOCSO, EIS and (A1788, from 1 June 2026) SKBBK wages. Act 612 s.2 "wages" (AGC reprint 2017) is basic salary, fixed allowances, leave pay and arrears: a one-off award is none of them, so outside the HRD levy. name: Past achievement, service excellence, innovation or productivity award
authority: ITA 1967 Schedule 6 para 25C (AGC online text as at 1 January 2026): a perquisite consisting of a past achievement, service excellence, innovation or productivity award, whether in money or otherwise, is exempt up to RM2,000 per employee per year of assessment — one cap shared with the long service award (which counts only after more than ten years with the same employer); LHDN Public Ruling 5/2019 Perquisites from Employment (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/PR_05_2019_2.pdf) para 7.1.1 and Example 11 (p.18): the RM2,000 covers the awards together. LHDN Specification for MTD Calculations Using Computerised Calculation 2026 (https://www.hasil.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/spesifikasi-kaedah-pengiraan-berkomputer-pcb-2026.pdf), E(9), pp.20–22, read 28 September 2026 item v: the exempt part is excluded from MTD remuneration and the rest is additional remuneration (D(b)(2) “bonus/incentive”); PCB.assessed_on subtracts the shared exemption. EPF Act 1991 s.2 “wages” (AGC text as at 1 July 2022) includes any bonus, commission or allowance and excludes any travelling allowance; KWSP employer FAQ (Mandatory Contribution, Q8 “Components of Wage”: salary, bonus, allowance, commission, incentives; Q11 “Non-Wages”: travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession; read 28 September 2026 in the browser): an award is a bonus or incentive, so EPF wages (additional). Act 4 s.2(24) (PERKESO BM reprint as at 1 July 2021) and Act 800 s.2 “wages” exclude (b) any travelling allowance or the value of any travelling concession, (c) sums to defray special expenses entailed by the nature of the employment, (d) a gratuity on discharge or retirement and (e) an annual bonus: an in-service award is none of these, so SOCSO, EIS and (A1788, from 1 June 2026) SKBBK wages.
